The exact public JavaScript from the Politika deployment of 17 November 2026 was read and SHA256-verified on 27 November 2026. Source URLs, identities and hashes are in worker/experiments/original-source-catalog.mjs. The original bytes are archived as base64 data in worker/experiments/original-source-bytes.json, so saving does not depend on the public URLs remaining available. This data is never evaluated in the dashboard or Worker. Tests verify, store and compose the exact bytes; loader execution tests use synthetic arm scripts only and never load publisher advertising networks.
